Voltorb

Electric

Kanto · Generation 1

Voltorb is an Electric-type Ball Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 10.4 kg. It evolves into Electrode. Its highest base stat is Speed (100), with a base stat total of 330.
